The climate in Poprad

Poprad is about 670 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 23°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −6°C. Around 920 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in July (about 114 mm). The highest temperature in Poprad in 2015–2024 was 32°C (1 July 2019) and the lowest −25°C (7 January 2017).

Best time to visit Poprad

The most pleasant weather in Poprad is usually in June, July and August: average highs are between 21°C and 23°C, with up to 16 days of rain a month. In January, February and December nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
